# Google Analytics 4 (GA4) MCP Server

> Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for Google Analytics 4 data exploration, schema discovery, and real-time metrics.

## Installation
- UVX: `uvx google-analytics-mcp`
- NPX: `npx -y @surendranb/google-analytics-mcp`
- Curl: `curl -fsSL https://ga4.builditwithai.xyz/install | bash`
- Documentation: https://ga4mcp.com
- Repo: https://github.com/surendranb/google-analytics-mcp

## Docs
Every page below also exists as markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or fetch the `.md` path directly.

- [Setup and troubleshooting](https://ga4mcp.com/setup/) · [markdown](https://ga4mcp.com/setup/index.md): missing GA4_PROPERTY_ID, missing credentials path, expired ADC.
- [Filter schema](https://ga4mcp.com/schema/) · [markdown](https://ga4mcp.com/schema/index.md): exact `dimension_filter` JSON shapes, camelCase and snake_case.
- [IAM permissions](https://ga4mcp.com/iam/) · [markdown](https://ga4mcp.com/iam/index.md): grant the service account Viewer access on the property.
- [Skills library](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/) · [markdown](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/index.md): 15 analytical recipes.

## Primary Tools
- `get_ga4_data(dimensions, metrics, date_range_start, date_range_end, dimension_filter, limit, estimate_only, proceed_with_large_dataset, enable_aggregation, intent)`: Runs structured reports; returns rows plus a server-computed `totals` block.
- `search_schema(keyword)`: Ranks dimension and metric API names for the property.
- `get_property_schema()`: Full dimension and metric schema.
- `list_dimension_categories()` / `list_metric_categories()`: Browse categories with counts.
- `get_dimensions_by_category(category)` / `get_metrics_by_category(category)`: Fields inside one category.
- `list_properties(account_id)`: Lists accessible GA4 properties.
- `search_skills(query)`: Serves one analytical recipe as markdown.
- `get_troubleshooting_guide(topic)`: Fixes for `setup`, `iam`, or `schema` errors.
- `setup_ga4_access()`: Collects a missing value interactively and reconnects.

## Skills
- [AI Referral Analysis](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/ai-referral-analysis/): measure traffic arriving from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot.
- [Attribution Scope](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/attribution-scope/): session-, user-, and event-scoped dimensions, and when each applies.
- [Bot Traffic Detection](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/bot-traffic-detection/): spot scrapers and spam sessions, then exclude them.
- [Channel Acquisition Analysis](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/channel-acquisition/): source, medium, and default channel group breakdowns.
- [Common Metric & Dimension Names](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/common-metric-names/): correct API names, including active users (MAU/WAU/DAU).
- [Compatible Dimension and Metric Combinations](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/compatible-combinations/): pairings the API accepts, and the ones that 400.
- [Content Performance Analysis](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/content-performance/): top pages, engagement, scroll depth, return visits.
- [Custom Dimensions and Event Parameters](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/custom-dimensions/): find and query `customEvent:*` and `customUser:*` fields.
- [Date Ranges](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/date-ranges/): relative date syntax, week-over-week, year-over-year, partial-day traps.
- [Ecommerce Analysis](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/ecommerce-analysis/): revenue, conversion rate, AOV, drop-off from purchase events.
- [Filter Structures](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/filter-structures/): `dimension_filter` templates for AND, OR, NOT, and IN LIST.
- [GA4 API Limitations](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/ga4-limitations/): what the Data API cannot answer — funnels, cohorts, paths, raw events.
- [Geo and Device Segmentation](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/geo-device-segmentation/): behaviour by country, city, device, and OS.
- [Traffic Change Diagnosis](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/traffic-diagnosis/): ordered steps to find the cause of a spike, drop, or mix shift.
- [UA to GA4 Field Name Mapping](https://ga4mcp.com/skills/ua-to-ga4/): every common Universal Analytics name and its GA4 equivalent.

## Machine Data
- [llms.txt](https://ga4mcp.com/llms.txt): this file, canonical copy.
- [llms-full.txt](https://ga4mcp.com/llms-full.txt): every docs and skills page inlined.
- [index.md](https://ga4mcp.com/index.md): the home page as markdown.
- [tools.json](https://ga4mcp.com/data/tools.json): all 11 tools with parameters and descriptions.
- [skills.json](https://ga4mcp.com/data/skills.json): skill slugs, titles, one-line descriptions.
- [sitemap.xml](https://ga4mcp.com/sitemap.xml) · [robots.txt](https://ga4mcp.com/robots.txt)

## Environment Variables
- `GA4_PROPERTY_ID`: Default GA4 property ID.
- `GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS`: Path to service account JSON key file.
- `DO_NOT_TRACK`, `DISABLE_TELEMETRY`, or `NO_TELEMETRY`: set to `1` to disable anonymous telemetry.
